overview: A sublease provision in a lease agreement governs a tenant's right to rent out all or part of a property to a third party (sublessee), usually requiring the landlord’s prior written consent. It establishes that the original tenant remains responsible for rent and obligations to the landlord, while acting as a "middleman" to the subtenant.
